items.title: Text formatting
items.text:
**bold text**
*italic text*
***bold and italic***
~~strikethrough~~
`inline code`

items.title: Links and images
items.text:
[Link text](https://example.com)
[Link with title](https://example.com "Hover title")
![Alt text](image.jpg)
![Image with title](image.jpg "Image title")

items.title: Lists
items.text:
Unordered:

- Item 1
- Item 2
  - Nested item

Ordered:

1. First item
2. Second item
3. Third item

items.title: Blockquotes
items.text:
> This is a blockquote
> Multiple lines
>> Nested quote

items.title: Code blocks
items.text:
```javascript
function hello() {
  console.log("Hello, world!");
}
```

items.title: Tables
items.text:
| Header 1 | Header 2 | Header 3 |
|----------|----------|----------|
| Row 1    | Data     | Data     |
| Row 2    | Data     | Data     |

items.text:
---
or
***
or

items.title: Task lists
items.text:
- [x] Completed task
- [ ] Incomplete task
- [ ] Another task

items.title: Escaping characters
items.text: Use backslash to escape: \* \_ \# \`

items.title: Line breaks
items.text:
End a line with two spaces  
to create a line break.

Or use a blank line for a new paragraph.

items.title: M1 Series Feature Support
items.text: This page details currently supported features on all M1 series (M1, M1 Pro, M1 Max, M1 Ultra) Apple Silicon Macs, as well as information about the status of other features.

items.title: Table of Contents
items.text:
• M1 SoC blocks
  • M1 devices
  • M1 Pro/Max/Ultra devices
  • Notes

items.title: M1 (T8103/H13G) SoC Blocks
items.text:
These are features/hardware blocks that are present on all devices with the given SoC.

Feature Description Working state SoC CPU cores Firestorm/Icestorm clusters Partially working (SMP still a tad bit fragile) DeviceTree Apple DeviceTree parsing (for UEFI specifically) Mostly working AIC Apple Interrupt Controller UEFI driver works, Windows HAL Extension needs more work NVMe Apple NVMe Storage coprocessor and onboard storage In progress Thunderbolt Thunderbolt 3 Not working (pending Apple Type-C bringup) DP Alt Mode USB-C DisplayPort out Not working (pending Apple Type-C bringup) AGX Apple's proprietary GPU Not working Display Controller Display output/DCP control Partially working (we're using iBoot's framebuffer) SEP Secure Enclave Not needed for now - optional SMC System Management Controller (Temperature, Fan Speed on Desktops, battery levels on laptops) Not working PCIe Apple PCIe Complex Not working (pending DART bringup) DART Apple's IOMMU In progress Wifi + Bluetooth Wi-Fi/Bluetooth chipsets Not working (contingent on PCIe bringup)

items.title: M1 Pro/Max/Ultra (T600x/H13S/C/D) SoC Blocks
items.text:
These are features/hardware blocks that are present on all devices with the given SoC.

Feature Description Working state SoC CPU cores Firestorm/Icestorm clusters Partially working (SMP still a tad bit fragile, multi-die untested) DeviceTree Apple DeviceTree parsing (for UEFI specifically) Mostly working AIC Apple Interrupt Controller UEFI driver works, Windows HAL Extension needs more work NVMe Apple NVMe Storage coprocessor and onboard storage In progress Thunderbolt Thunderbolt 3 Not working (pending Apple Type-C bringup) DP Alt Mode USB-C DisplayPort out Not working (pending Apple Type-C bringup) AGX Apple's proprietary GPU Not working Display Controller Display output/DCP control Partially working (we're using iBoot's framebuffer) SEP Secure Enclave Not needed for now - optional SMC System Management Controller (Temperature, Fan Speed on Desktops, battery levels on laptops) Not working PCIe Apple PCIe Complex Not working (pending DART bringup) DART Apple's IOMMU In progress Wifi + Bluetooth Wi-Fi/Bluetooth chipsets Not working (contingent on PCIe bringup)

items.title: Mac Mini (M1, 2020) J274AP
items.text: Feature Working state USB-A Ports Partially working (only input and partial storage) Ethernet No drivers yet, Not working HDMI Out Display output type, basic iBoot Framebuffer only for now

items.title: MacBook Air (M1, 2020) J313AP
items.text: Feature Working state USB-C Ports Partially working (only input and partial storage) Battery Untested Built-in display Working Built-in keyboard and trackpad Not working

items.title: MacBook Pro (M1, 2020) J293AP
items.text: Feature Working state USB-C Ports Partially working (only input and partial storage) Battery Untested Built-in display Working Built-in keyboard and trackpad Not working Touch Bar Not working
